notes.title: The Start of First Dwarf Playtest!
notes.content:
How are you today, Dwarves? Excited as we are? We sure hope so! 🍀🌟

[h3]3…2…1… Off you go to the Driftland world! IGN Gameplay[/h3]

Let’s start with some amazing news! IGN released a 15 minute long video with the newest gameplay of First Dwarf! Accompanied by an informative voice over, you can dive into the fantasy world of Driftland and see the most up to date mechanics, graphics and systems that we’ve been working on! It’s a great opportunity to get to know the specifics of our game in a very detailed way. 🛠🤖

You can check it out below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Yo2cw3P3AE

[h3]First Ever First Dwarf Playtest[/h3]

And without further ado… Today is a [b]BIG[/b] day for us! If you’ve been following our Community Hub and our social media, you could’ve heard about sign-ups for our Playtests. But in case you somehow didn’t get the memo, don’t worry! Put on your dwarven shoes anyway, because you can still join us! Just go to the Steam page of First Dwarf and click “Request Access” 🎯

[h3]Who will get access?[/h3]

Everyone who signed-up will participate! 🎉 So no worries, it doesn't matter if you requested it right after our announcement, or even after the Playtest started, you’ll be able to play First Dwarf. 🎉

[h3]When does the Playtest start and end?[/h3]

Playtests are open from March 25th 3PM (CET) to April 8th 3PM (CEST). We’re going to give access to the game to everyone who signed-up. In this time window, you can still request access to the game. After April 8th, the Playtests will be closed, gamers will lose their access to the game, but there is a possibility of a second round in the future.

[h3]What exactly is the Playtest and why are we organizing it?[/h3]

Steam Playtest is a wonderful feature that lets us give access to the game to the players who are willing to try it out in its current state. Our main reason for this, is willingness to receive as much feedback as we can, before launching the final game. We believe that the thoughts and opinions of our community will help us shape the game together and create something truly brilliant. We deeply care about this project, as it’s related to our first game, Driftland: The Magic Revival, and we are over the moon that we have the opportunity to expand this magical world even further. That’s why we need YOUR HELP!

[h3]But how can I help?[/h3]

Well, that’s super easy! After getting access to the game…just play the game! That’s phase number one. And phase number two, is…

[h3]Leave your Feedback![/h3]

There are [b]3 places[/b] where you can report bugs, issues and leave feedback!

[h3]First method is:[/h3]
[list]
[*] First Dwarf Discord server
[/list]
We highly encourage you all to leave us your feedback, even if it’s just a few words (but the more you say, the better, of course!). You can do it in our First Dwarf Discord server, which we already upgraded with special channels for the Playtest. If you already are on our Discord, you know that it’s really fun there!

[url=https://discord.gg/rr4nDK545C][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png[/img][/url]

We added two new channels specifically for this event:

[b]playtest-feedback -[/b] that’s the place where you can tell us EVERYTHING you want after you played our game. Positive and negative feedback, all of that is welcome. You can tell us about the smallest things, regarding music, characters, dialogues, mechanics, systems, bugs… Every topic is a good topic, as long as it’s related to the First Dwarf Playtest. We can’t wait to chat with you about your experiences with our title! 

[b]opt-in-credits -[/b] here you can read the steps of what to do, to be included in our game’s credits! It’s a little “thank you” from us, for all your help. By leaving your invaluable feedback, you’re becoming an important part of our big adventure! You’ll find there the link to the form we prepared earlier, where you’ll be able to drop your nickname. No offensive names of course, those won’t be included.

[h3]Second method for leaving feedback:[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the game itself, as seen below
[/list]
Probably the fastest way to report a bug is located directly in the game. An automatic save file is also attached to the report you make (but you won't see it, so don't panic!), so we have the best understanding of the issue. However, keep in mind that we won’t be able to respond to you there. We will receive the information, but to hear back from us or to engage in conversation, it’s best to use Discord.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8dc5c9fb5261fa46563efe193510f9861a50f77e.png[/img]

[h3]Third method to leave feedback:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Discussion dedicated to the event
[/list]
We made a pinned thread in the Steam Discussions titled 🐛 Playtest Bug Reports 🐛, where you can report your bugs from the Playtest. 

[h3]Fill the Form![/h3]

If you’re not sure how to phrase what’s in your mind, we prepared a simple form to fill, which may help you transfer your thoughts into words and inspire you in terms of what to be aware of while playing. After leaving your feedback, you can also write your preferred name to be put in the credits there, it’s optional.

[url=https://forms.gle/zkZLTsh76H6CePz37]Feedback Form First Dwarf[/url]

[h3]Available Languages[/h3]

We deeply care about your experience with First Dwarf and that’s why we prepared additional languages for the Playtest. Which include:

Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, German, Greek, English, Spanish - Spain, French, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0d0aa32c000b92daa7dd1a0c36f75c6e860fb09d.gif[/img]

Please have in mind that the game is still in progress and so are the languages, so translations may have some mistakes. We apologize for that. They are in beta version, and will be improved with time. You can change the language in the game’s menu options! Texts and dialogues can also be altered later, if necessary.

[h3]Can I stream my game?📸[/h3]

[b]YES![/b] Feel free to tag us and show off on our Discord server, we would love to see it! You can freely post about it on your social media. Even more! You can use our Press Kit, if you wish:

[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1UbDP9xMuMtEHYYUh09j6nQjyoLC164cn]First Dwarf Press Kit[/url]

[h3]What’s in the Playtest?[/h3]

The best part! What’s awaiting you during our Playtest? Well, let us tell you!

You’ll be playtesting an introduction to our game, First Dwarf. Take on the role of Tru, chosen to be the First Dwarf and his sassy dragon companion Ragna. Your mission is to build a new colony on the freshly discovered island, but first, you need to make sure that the area is safe to inhabit. Gather resources, build your base and fortify your colony, before the evil monster wave attacks! Fight your enemies by placing defensive turrets and engaging in direct combat. Complete your quests and send the raven to the awaiting dwarves, so they can arrive at their new home. Will you and your people survive in this new environment? 🧔‍♂️🐉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/da2a9c9e559fc6d0034726e4cd932c11aeadba0c.gif[/img]

[h3]❤️ Add to Your Wishlist ❤️[/h3]

We’re also preparing an advanced special version of Demo, titled First Dwarf: First Island. We highly encourage you to add it to your Wishlist (it has its own Steam Page) as well as the final First Dwarf game. We will give more information soon! It will help us show the world that the love people have for dwarves is immeasurable.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865680/First_Dwarf_First_Island/

[h3]Final Thoughts[/h3]

And that’s basically it! Easy, right? If you have ANY additional questions, don’t be afraid and ask us on our Discord server or in the comments. We hope to discuss with you many, many different topics and create a wonderful game together!

Have fun playing First Dwarf and see you in our Discord server!

[i]Yours,[/i]
Star Drifters Team ✨🚀

notes.title: Driftland Update - Are you a Driftland Specialist?
notes.content:
[h3]Mages!🧙‍♂️[/h3]

We see a lot of newcomers here! But no matter, if you’re just starting as an Apprentice Mage or if you’ve got a whole prospering empire as an Archmage, we’ve got some news for you!

We made an update fixing some minor bugs occurring in the game and added the logo of our upcoming game, First Dwarf. It takes place in the world of Driftland and is an big expansion of its lore. Control dwarven scouting engineer Tru, dragon Ragna or powerful mech and explore the uncharted islands in search of a new home for your people. This immersive action RPG fuses quick combat with base building and tower defense. 

We absolutely love that universe and hope that if you liked the twisted and magical stories of Driftland: The Magic Revival, you will also enjoy First Dwarf!

[previewyoutube=U5C4TOFc8uw;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/

But First Dwarf is just the beginning, though! We would love to continue our adventure in Driftland, as much as you do! [url=https://www.change.org/p/show-the-studio-star-drifters-how-much-we-want-a-game-centered-on-elves]We’ve seen your petition regarding the making of a game with elf characters[/url]… What a nice initiative! Who knows what the future will bring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/b6c77b608718e4e3eaceeb3ba3e7763a01a4729c.png[/img]

[h3]I finished Driftland… What else have you got?[/h3]

We’ve got Nomads of Driftland - a standalone free expansion! As you may know, Driftland: The Magic Revival has a unique fusion of RTS, 4X strategy, and Sim genres. This helps you command all your units without micromanagement, thanks to the flag system.

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbmY4cHV2cHN5MngyajAxMTFrNmRva25leTQ2bnN2ejRoYjJrejRqZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4EOOfqSmCaXBInTt3X/giphy.gif[/img]

Contrary to that, Nomads of Driftland has a more classic RTS feel and is significantly different from the base game, as units are managed directly. It will be full of new experiences for you!

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdmQ2cXAzMTZxbDBmMDY2MWU2NWE4OGYzMDExdzltcXFueGd1ZTN4eiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hLHDqXUeXlBr92YqLC/giphy.gif[/img]

Unlike in the base game, Nomads of Driftland do not have a ruler and do not carry out orders like previous races. Also, new unit types and classes affect strategy on the battlefield!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1400520/Nomads_of_Driftland/

And if you want even more…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/a4de64829bfa12cddaca5ab9b5055c004b15724c.jpg[/img]

You can always check out the DLC for Nomads of Driftland called Nomads of Driftland: The Forgotten Passage, which adds 10 new scenarios to the game. Explore the world of floating islands to the fullest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1436970/Nomads_of_Driftland_The_Forgotten_Passage/

[h3]Custom Maps[/h3]

If all of the above is already no news to you, Archmage, you can download custom maps in the Steam Workshop. The fun never ends! And even more - [url=steamcommuhttps://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=718650&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitemsnity.com]you can create a custom map in the game editor and upload it to the Workshop yourself[/url]. ☝ Show us what you’ve got!

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExam5xdjJqZmUzcGhwejg1Mnp6bTVnNzc0cTN6c2VmcWx5ZXNudGF0byZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/xdoKp1Zwul3CFtWY0p/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Bright Future[/h3]

We are so happy that you decided to play Driftland and we’re always happy to hear from you! What characters do you like the most? Which game system do you prefer? What wild animal do you like to tame the most and what spells are your favorite? Tell us! 

And feel free to check out our social media and join our Discord servers, especially since we’re approaching the playtest stage for First Dwarf. Discord server users will gain access to it in the first place. You don’t want to miss this opportunity!

Oh, one more thing. It's the 14th of February…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/e311ac4c7c628c2d4d6e66228af8d4afd010017b.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/veBzGK6mje][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/8b5afe298038642725abf9e9b2bf6aeb1d689210.png[/img][/url]

May your islands float peacefully through the skies! ☀☁ See ya! ☀☁

Star Drifters Team 🚀

notes.title: First Dwarf ladies & gentlemen! 🍻 We were waiting to long to announce this game
notes.content:
Long time no see? 🤔

Not really. These past few weeks have been extremely busy for us. We announced two new games. You fell in love with Scorchlands 🐦, now it’s time to share with the world the project that we work on for the longest period of time. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090100/Scorchlands/

Long story short.

[h2]First Dwarf is an immersive open world action adventure RPG with base building elements, set in the world of Driftland: The Magic Revival. 🧙‍♂️[/h2]

Our new game will tell the story of Tru (the dwarf in a mech you see above) and his best dragon 🐉 friend Ragna (c’mon, you remember her from our previous Driftland games). 

At this moment, we’ll not share too much about the game, but we’ve got to share something, right? ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/ebf229e63b84253537bcafb2471e41a179c62f18.png[/img]

Here’s what you need to know at the moment (5 points):
[list]
[*] there’s a trailer on IGN’s YouTube channel, watch it here
[previewyoutube=ZKC-fx7Vl88;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] we’ll be showing First Dwarf on PAX West 2022, starting September 2 (tomorrow);
[*] make sure to check out our Social Media: [url=https://www.facebook.com/StarDrifters.games/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/StarDrifters]Twitter[/url] 🐤, and [url=https://www.instagram.com/star_drifters/]Instagram [/url]📷, will be posting there some fun stuff;
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/JY9xk4z5Zj]here’s the dedicated Discord 🎧 server[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/]wishlist the game on Steam[/url]
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/

Main features of First Dwarf:
🍺 Explore the world in mana-powered mechanical armor. Upgrade it to unlock new exciting abilities that will help you with discovering new locations in the vast open world in the clouds.
🍺 Build various structures to defend yourself and to establish a new colony for your people.
🍺 Fight the numerous dangers of the Driftland’s wildlands: barbarian tribes, wild creatures, or natural disasters. Secure the area and make it more hospitable for dwarven settlers.
🍺 Unveil the mysterious secrets of the ancients, while unveiling the story of the hero’s family. 

Here’s a nice screenshot from new build:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/925258abbc03150bdb3903a0730835f71669416f.jpg[/img]

To unveil the mystery about the gameplay… 🗺️

Game pillars:
[list]
[*] crafting (you’ll be controlling a dwarf engineer, not a warrior);
[*] story (with an emphasis on…)
[*] relationship (between Ragna and Tru, between dwarves in a clan, etc.),
[*] exploration + movement + scavenging (the world you’ll be experiencing will be diverse),
[*] freedom of choice (YOUR approach to the game is one of the most important aspects of us during the creation of First Dwarf).
[/list]

That’s a wrap - welcome to the tale of Tru and Ragna!
Now it’s time to fully unblur our cover photo on Facebook and Twitter, so… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/a669e4df30869b6b95dcdf731998c276dc94ff5e.png[/img]

Wishlist First Dwarf on Steam, join the game’s Discord 🎧 server, and follow us on Facebook 👍 and Twitter 🐦.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/

Yours truly,
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.title: Scorchlands 🐦 - check out adorable new fantasy game published by us! 🚀
notes.content:
Hello Mages, 👋

gamescom 2022 is just around the corner, but we decided to show the world a new game published by us, Star Drifters 🚀, a few days before the event will start. When we saw Scorchlands for the first time, we knew right from the bat that this project was interesting. We felt that after the first chats with Jakub, the developer behind the name Ringlab, we were on the same page from the very beginning. What’s more, he told us that he admires Driftland - The Magic Revival 🐲 and is a fan of our game. Then we knew something was in the air, so today we’re here to announce to the whole world that:

<snares> 🥁

1️⃣ Scorchlands by Ringlab will be published by Star Drifters 🚀!

[previewyoutube=bjYEg5katr4;full][/previewyoutube]

2️⃣ The demo version will be available on Steam in just a few days! 💪

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090100/Scorchlands/

3️⃣ If you want to find out more about the gameplay and the lore (these running “birds” are not exactly birds, they’re Giwis! 🐦) - read the Steam News published on Scorchlands Steam page, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090100/Scorchlands/]clicking here[/url].

Scorchalnds is a game in which you manage production of fantastic resources on a foreign, volcanic moon. Play at your own pace and relax in a setting that combines magic and science.

Main features of Scorchlands 👀

[list]
[*] Hex grid-based city-building – construct various buildings in your colonies. Each structure's productivity depends on neighboring resources and other constructions.
[*] Complex resource management – it’s not only about extracting materials. Scorchlands takes account of logistics – the movement of resources between colonies and combining them in robust processing chains. And yes, we move resources using LASERS!
[*] Terraforming for the greater good – use magic and technology to change the biomes on procedurally generated maps and exploit the new environment to gain its unique resources
[*] Technology designed to give fun – there’s no fun in a sandbox if you don’t have the toys to play with. The technology system in Scorchlands is key for player progression and new discoveries open up new ways to play with the game world
[*] Minimalistic combat system – when you get into a fight, positioning will be the key. Destroy your enemies by surrounding them and placing your forces in optimal locations.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/c788a796bd7e6f658922322d814736e4ca9a200b.png[/img]

Remember: there’s one more blurred screenshot on our SM cover photos. 
Today we can say that everybody in our team likes un-blurring things. The last game will be a part of Drifltland franchise. 👀

Wishlist Scorchlands on Steam, join the game’s Discord 🎧 server, follow Ringlab on [url=https://twitter.com/ringglan]Twitter [/url]and us, Star Drifters 🚀, on [url=https://www.facebook.com/StarDrifters.games]Facebook [/url]👍 and [url=https://twitter.com/StarDrifters]Twitter [/url]🐦.

Your,
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.title: Star Drifters recap
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/37547bab3d30a82d7db45227a874bfff4b8d5fde.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 👋

you probably wonder why there’s a graphic with a screen taken from the Nintendo Switch 🎮 version of Danger Scavenger. The answer is simple - we wanted to make an announcement summarizing our work done between January and July of 2022 - when we’re writing these words, Driftland is still our most popular franchise. 🌲

Unfortunately, nothing really happened during this period in Driftland camp. Nonetheless, you can get the game in many discounts that pop up every once in a while (usually during Steam/GOG offers/events). But, y’know, there’s always something cookin’. ♨ Be patient.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/2f8424598909bae3c60b575fc912d21ea396a31e.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/718650/Driftland_The_Magic_Revival/

[h1]Danger Scavenger[/h1]

That’s where the fun starts. First of all - we’re flattered that DS is featured on the back of the [b]Atari VCS box[/b]. Ta-da! 🎉

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/68ec192ba36b75171cc891d762706687b362de7d.png[/img]

When [b]Steam Deck [/b]was on its way, we did everything to make sure that the game would run perfectly on the “second” handheld from day one. After that, we received an official Steam Deck verification in May. Speaking about the “first” handheld, just a reminder - [b]Danger Scavenger[/b] is available on [b]PC, PS4, XONE, Switch, VCS[/b] and [b]XSX[/b]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/c15dfd345141b02b9005abd96832472137d76cb0.jpg[/img]

We’re always looking for new ways of approaching the titles that we already published. When we started talking with the [b]Tilt Five[/b] team, we knew that their [b]Holographic Gaming System[/b] would be a great place for a skyscraper-based roguelike. That’s why we made a dedicated [b]DLC [/b]to bring the catchphrase “a new level of the 3D vibrant holographic environment" to DS rooftops! 🌆

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ed22b76333715d0e33298d2ff77347e56d27d0f0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/20123869e38e7254ea40fdd7bd43f147f7d12d26.jpg[/img]

[h1]Lumencraft[/h1]

When devs from [b]2Dynamic Games[/b] started the playtests, we were convinced that approx. 200 people will check out the game during the two weeks of that phase. Well, there were [b]1312 participants[/b]. The feedback submitted by playtesters gave us a new perspective on the game. We knew that we chose the right project for publishing.

The [b]Lumencraft [/b]section of this Steam announcement will be the longest one, because the game’s still in Early Access and currently it’s a project no. 1 in our catalog. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713810/Lumencraft/

After the first week of EA we reached the 20k copies milestone. None of us expected that this will happen so fast, so Kuba Wójcik came up with a meme idea.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/be9a75f964c9606a8e5a8f469a4aa6c4266c71f7.png[/img]

We won’t share how many copies were sold, but we can say that as the indie publishers - we’re satisfied. 😏

Today, exactly 3 months after the start of Early Access (which happened April 13th, 2022) we would like to thank everyone who wrote a review on Steam. The numbers speak for themselves. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/34129bc80a88a4be9bad0b73d6afeac1e0ffac06.png[/img]

During the playtests, “2Ds” organized the [b]MAKE A MAP, WIN A PRIZE[/b] contest. 10 maps were published via Steam Workshop - 3 guys won Danger Scavenger and Driftland: The Magic Revival Steam keys. The ideas behind the contest were continued in the Maps Shootout series. When we’re writing these words there are [b]123 maps submitted to the Workshop[/b]. 🤯

Lots of them are truly pieces of art that reshape Lumencraft’s gameplay. The summary of all Maps Shootouts installments can be found in our Stories highlights on our Instagram.

What’s more, the game was shown at this year’s:
[b]- European Game Showcase during GDC;
- PAX East;
- Digital Dragons 🐲.[/b]

To this day, the [b]2Dynamic Games[/b] team is working closely with the game’s community. When [b]Early Access[/b] starts (after the playtests), the developers published:
- 3 hotfixes;
- 4 small updates;
- two major updates;
- and we’re pretty much sure we forgot about something. 💊

They added new weapons, buildings, monsters, maps and scenarios, textures, new UI, and fixed A LOT. Lumencraft is now more approachable to semi-casual players, but it does not collide with the hardcore players - there are extremely hard maps available to enjoy (or suffer a bit). 😈 

That’s all for today.

Or maybe at the beginning of 2022?

notes.content:
[h3]Yes! It's been 3 years since Driftland debuted in Steam Early Access ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

When we reach for the memory for the game that we dared to present to you in Early Access three years ago, we can't believe how long we've come with you - our great community. We spent countless hours discussing new game features that we later implemented in Driftland: The Magic Revival. Simultaneously, we worked on complex, game-deepening mechanics and simplifications for those entering the world of strategy games. We were constantly struggling to create an original game with pioneering solutions and simultaneously understandable and similar to what we all know and like in strategy games. During these three years of development, we released dozens of updates that introduced hundreds of new features and improvements to make Driftland: The Magic Revival the game it is today.

All this makes us feel great pride and, at the same time, grateful that we can enjoy the world of Driftland together with you for 3 years.

[b]Thank you![/b]

The Anniversary Update introduces some important new features while also correcting minor bugs you have reported to us.

[h3]Map Editor and Workshop integration[/h3]

The most important new feature of the Anniversary Update is the first public version of the Map Editor, which will allow you to create your own maps with islands of unusual shapes and arrangements. In turn, thanks to the Workshop, you will be able to easily share your maps and download maps created by other players.

[previewyoutube=VfXGHALx9OY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NOMADS & Driftland 2.0
notes.content:
[i]The promise to restore civilization to its former shape and return to the times of splendor overcame sadness and filled the hearts of Driftland's inhabitants with new hope and energy. Determination for action diverted attention from the numerous conflicts between quarrelsome mage-rulers and various injuries sustained by those who did not give in to their will. 
Outlaw rebels, by the mage-rulers called Nomads are exterminated and treated as barbarians. They believe that the new order is an attempt to restore balance in shape that has once destroyed the planet.
Now, the Nomads must fight to defend their values and survive.[/i]

[b]Dear players![/b]

We are pleased to present to you the latest and also the largest Driftland update so far. Thanks to the great Driftland fan community, we've had the opportunity to develop the game together during early access and after the release. 
We hope that you will like the effect of the last few months of our work and that we will be able to further expand the magical world of Driftland.

[h1]What's new in version 2.0:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Nomads - new game mode[/b]
Nomads do not have a ruler and do not carry out orders like other races. Units are managed directly, like in classic RTS games. New unit types/classes affect strategy on the battlefield. Path of Progress tree The Nomad economy is not based on resources as much as in other races.

[*] [b]Free Game - extended game mode replacing Skirmish[/b]
A game mode that allows you to generate a random game just like before Skirmish, with the difference that we've added a lot of options that will allow you to create a game on your own inventory and more varied maps.

[*] [b]Cross-Play and new multiplayer engine[/b]
With this update, Steam and GOG players will be able to play a multiplayer game together. By the way, we changed the multiplayer game engine, which should improve the stability of the game in this mode.

[*] [b]Tutorial[/b]
We've had two tutorials so far - one in Skirmish mode and the other in Campaign mode. Unfortunately, each of them contained a different part of the knowledge needed to play Driftland. Some of you played only one of them and did not look into the other, which sometimes could cause frustration. We decided to sort it out and create an independent game mode - Tutorial, which quickly teaches how to navigate the world of Driftland and introduces the basic mechanics. We also got rid of the tutorial mission in the human campaign, which you just didn't like :-)
The Nomads got their own tutorial mission because they use a completely different game mechanics.

[*] [b]NVIDIA GeForce NOW support[/b]
Now you can play Driftland: The Magic Revival wherever you want using the GeForce NOW service.

[*] [b]Other improvements[/b]
- different modes of operation of the improved defense towers depending on the race
- new nested UI windows
- improving the operation of some (units) skills that were not felt well enough
and many more
- key bindings have been extended and improved
- optimizations for larger numbers of units on the screen
- fixed Ritual flag
- fixed tutorial achievement
[/list]

Finally, we have one more surprise for our players who also like the roguelike genre or the twin-stick shooters with permadeath in general.
Together with Piotr Wolk, we are working on a cyberpunk skyline crawler heavily inspired by Outrun and Vaporwave aesthetics. We are at the beginning of our path with this project, but we dream to build such a strong community as Driftland has.
[b]Until July 9, every Driftland user can buy a Danger Scavenger with an additional 20% discount, which adds up to a 10% premiere discount = [u]30%[/u] cheaper :-) [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

notes.title: Update 1.3.4
notes.content:
[h1]Brave Mages![/h1]

This update introduces a number of user experience improvements and fixes that have been discussed and requested by the Driftland community in recent weeks. At the same time, we've synced all three development branches: Steam PC, Steam macOS, and GOG to version 1.3.x

[h1]Gamepad🎮[/h1]

Gamepad support introduced in the previous update has been improved with many new features and has become more convenient. Therefore, from the experimental test version it changed into a full-fledged game feature.

[h1]DRM-Free[/h1]

Fulfilling the requests with version 1.3.x, Driftland becomes DRM-Free. For most of you, nothing changes, the game works and starts as before. 
However, for players who treat DRM (Digital Rights Management) as a restriction of ownership, this is a significant change that allows running the game without Steam and effectively creating an offline backup. However, please note that to use some of Dritland features like Steam Cloud save games, cloud campaign progress save, multiplayer mode, and achievements, the Steam client must be running in the background.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Since the previous update we have introduced several hundred changes and fixes in the source code of the game. The result is the elimination of many rare but annoying bugs that occur in specific situations, e.g. the (in)correct numbering of camps (and raids) during their frequent creation and removal.
The second group of changes and fixes improved the game's performance and stability. Here we owe a huge thank you to our wonderful community, which provided us a lot of feedback, game saves, and logs. 
❤️Thank you!❤️

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings fellow Mages🧙🏼‍♀️🧙🧙🏿‍♀️🧝![/h1]

Most of you enjoy the relaxed pace at which life takes place on the planet Driftland, often taking advantage of a moment of reflection and planning during an active pause. On the other hand, the time in our game can be accelerated to shorten the wait for the effect of your decisions. 
We got a lot of feedback that the middle rate of time acceleration changes too little, and the maximum acceleration is not enough so the game is still too slow for some players.
Improving a time acceleration mechanics turned out to be quite a challenge. First of all, we could not spoil the game to people who like to play in a relaxed way, and secondly, excessive acceleration of time negatively affected the performance of AI and game optimization. This would be unacceptable and put into question the possibility of implementing these changes...

[h1]⏩ 50% Faster Game⭐[/h1]
We did it! With version 1.2.8 in Driftland you can play 50% faster at a full speed, the middle time acceleration has been increased by 33% while maintaining full AI and game performance.
⭐The standard (unaccelerated) pace of the game and the active pause remain intact

[h1]🎮 Beta Support for Gamepads [/h1](PC only)
An alternative game control model supporting gamepads has been added. This is a beta version that we will develop but you can now try how it works. The control mode is changed automatically - moving any gamepad knob activates the alternative control mode. To return to the standard mode, just move the mouse.
We welcome your comments and ideas in our Steam Community page:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/718650/discussions/

[h1]Bug Fixes🐛[/h1]
Thank you to our community for vigilance and bug reports.[list]
[*]FIXED "negative damage and armor"
[*]FIXED "ridiculous building repair speed"
[*]FIXED "permanent debuff from spells & combat"
[*]FIXED "giant army couldn't scratch the enemy castle"
[*]FIXED "cropped second digit of the level value in units list window" 
[*]minor bug fixes
[*]ADDED screen resolution reset - return to the optimal graphics mode - type "reset" at any time during the game or in the menu
[/list]

Happy 🎃Halloween🎃 and let's your treats outnumber your tricks👻

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/945087387508037441/292F937E4F0761B39E04C1154FC501F29CD6FB20/[/img]

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

We want to thank all players❤️ who contacted us directly, sharing their ideas and reporting bugs that we immediately corrected in small, silent updates that extended the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/718650/announcements/detail/1609388832792468756]Community Update 1.1.25[/url]

It significantly expands and complements the existing way of managing units and allows recruitment without searching the map for a building in which we have a free slot.[/list]

[list]
    [*]minor bug fixes
[/list]

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

notes.title: Update 1.1.25a
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/48eb39416118af3a50bcda3f5d0c81e1a41bd8ae.gif[/img]

[h1]Dear Mages,[/h1]

One of the advantages of being a small, independent team is the flexibility and close contact of developers and players. We talk, listen and draw conclusions used during the development of new game features.

In this update, we present features that we have developed based on your feedback, and even in a few cases with your active participation for which we thank you❤️

[h1]New Difficulty Levels[/h1]

This is the most important change over which we have been working for several weeks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/c7abd050a9294254872d1d5c419131d025349199.png[/img]

Driftland is a complex and demanding strategy game. New levels of difficulty are to make new players smooth and enjoyable to learn and master the rules of Driftland.

On the other hand, those of you who have been with us for a long time and have mastered the game, ask for bigger challenges, especially in the end game, which we also took care of ːsteamhappyː

[list]
[*] [b]Apprentice Mage[/b] - For those who calmly want to learn the game or those who do not like to fight too much and prefer to focus on building their kingdoms
[*] [b]Brave Mage[/b] - New default difficulty mode. For magicians who are not afraid to face an opponent, but at the same time do not like to pay too much attention to balancing their economy...
[*] [b]Great Mage[/b] - For those who have learned the rules and are looking for new challenges. At this level, the players will face the ruthless enemy and at the same time will have to carefully look after their economy.
[*] [b]Archmage[/b] - For those who have mastered all the rules perfectly. Demanding economy and hostile AI, which is determined to destroy enemies and fiercely defend even in the face of inevitable defeat.
[/list]
We made sure not to spoil the experience of players who have so far been satisfied with their previous levels of difficulty.
[list]
[*] If you liked the [b]EASY[/b] mode the most, choose [b]Apprentice Mage[/b].
[*] If [b]MEDIUM[/b] seems perfect to you, [b]Great Mage[/b] will meet your expectations
[*] For [b]HARD[/b], simply choose [b]Archmage[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Auto-Open ☑️[/h1]

We have added the option of disabling windows that pop up after setting the flag, e.g. geology flag: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/669530c722d062564bba516a8968c71d78582332.png[/img]

Experienced players who perfectly know the contents of these windows will definitely want to turn off the [b]Auto-Open[/b] feature. By turning off the auto-opening of the flag windows, they will be able to put flags one after the other at a higher speed. Disabling this feature will also solve the problem of people who are irritated by pop-ups during the fight.

[h1]Other Improvements in 1.1.24[/h1]

[list]
[*] Resource Preview - when using the geology flag or spells extracting resources from the islands, information about available resources appears, making it easier to decide on the choice of island. The resource available to be extracted using the spell will be marked.
[*] AI - the rate of repair of buildings adapted to the degree of difficulty: 30%, 50%, 70%, 100% respectively.
[*] Multiplayer - data management optimizations that can potentially prevent disconnection in case of significant lags
[*] Multiplayer - improved color reproduction to increase the readability of the chat
[*] Multiplayer - after pressing ESC, accidental clicking on the screen will not close the menu window
[*] Improved UI Scaling - applies to campaign windows
[*] Optimizations and improvements in the structure of materials (normal maps)
[*] Improved shader of the marked/active islands
[*] Minor Animation improvements
[*] Fixed - an issue with Ibaros making one tier 3 unit of each type ineligible to mount
[*] Bug Fixes - a few rare and difficult to track bugs were found and fixed 
[*] Various minor fixes in campaigns
[/list]

[h1]Hot Fix 1.1.25[/h1]
released on Jun. 18th 2019
[list]
[*] Fixed - incorrect total number of heroes given when buying skills in the library, blacksmith, etc.
[*] in the recruitment window, a preview of the daily cost of the heroes and explorers has been added
[*] minor language corrections in the English language version
[/list]

[h1]Hot Fix 1.1.25a[/h1]
[*] Fixed - eliminated  the possibility of falling into a conflict within one team or co-op in a multiplayer type game
[/list]

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

notes.title: Big Dragon Update🐉
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/b040ee3200b0b5a7ff3cfcf9d69fb88c1d935eb1.gif[/img]

[i]Powerful mage, only you can decide the fate of Driftland! Shattered pieces of the planet await your ultimate power, and the helpless citizens of your Empire turn their eyes to you, trusting your guidance. You are their last hope -  only a few have the power to break the chains that hold the mystery behind Driftland and to unite the planet![/i]
[i]Yours sincerely,
Archseeker[/i]

[h1]Update Notes 1.1.17[/h1]

There was no better time to claim your legacy - Driftland has just received 🐉 BIG DRAGON UPDATE  that makes the story complete, poses new challenges to single player mode, and introduces new online game modes.

[h1]Final Story Campaign[/h1]

This is it. After 3 story campaigns, here is the 4th and final one coming. You have met Emeric, a young reckless mage who dared to oppose Dark Elves. You saw Dark Elves’ leader Shalh’yra trying to make peace with Humans. You witnessed Dwarves looking for a magic artifact  that will keep their race alive and you saw them struggling to accept a female as their leader. Now you will meet Wild Elves’ Lanahel,[spoiler]that protects his realm from the other races, who will suddenly discover the truth behind all conflict in Driftland.[/spoiler] 
This is the story about tolerance and prejudice, friendship and loyalty, blind faith and open mind. Now this story is coming to an end...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/56e843f8bee9ffc905822b06a03a35085e40d88e.gif[/img]

The first three campaigns can be played in any order. The exception is the last one, which requires winning the previous three. Each of them unlocks one padlock on the chains blocking the final campaign. 

[h1]New Multiplayer Modes[/h1]

1) [b]Co-op Mode[/b]
Play together with a friend and fight the enemy. Brace yourselves, because they are coming for you!

2) [b]Team Multiplayer Mode[/b]
2vs2 or 3vs3 - there are two ways to prove who has the better alliance out there. Grab your team, taunt the other, get your economy right and 4X them!

[h1]Discord[/h1]

We've added support for Discord rich presence. Driftland is now visible in the "Now Playing" section of the User Profile, along with information about current activity in the game. We hope that thanks to this feature you will also make new friends and have a great time together in the new Co-op and Team Modes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/6dce5cd6b6c668d76b81916282b8fdc384e5c2bc.png[/img]

BTW. Our Discord server: https://discordapp.com/invite/driftland

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] End Game AI is more efficient in rebuilding a destroyed army
[*] AI uses a full range of spells
[*] AI actively improves its capabilities using the Paths of Progress
[*] proofreading of English and Russian and minor corrections in other languages
[*] dozens of new animations (mostly Wild Elves)
[*] a lot of new graphics related to the 4th campaign
[*] Improved readability of the marked / active island (shader patch)
[*] perfecting graphics - minor graphic improvements that we did not have time for
[/list]

Driftland has come a long way and has become a complete and mature game. Our community❤️ played a huge role in development for which we are extremely grateful. 🤗 Your creativity and commitment has surprised us many times and that's why we're starting to work on an editor that will allow you to create your own maps. More details soon!

The last question that remains unanswered is "Why Big Dragon"? There are no shortcuts here - you have to discover it yourself by playing the final campaign ːsteamhappyː

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.18
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/faa55091d4d70e71c050a54edeb8f125469b2b96.gif[/img]

[h1]Dear Mages![/h1]

In this update, we focused on the features we have developed based on your❤️ feedback, comments and reviews. At the same time, we are approaching the release of the final campaign, so we want to prepare the game in advance.

[h1]Improved Campaign Mode[/h1]

The most important change is the reconstruction of the Campaign mode. From now on, the first three campaigns can be played in any order. Their plot is designed so that the main threads fit together and complement each other regardless of the order in which they will be completed. The exception will be the fourth, final campaign, which will require the completion of the three preceding campaigns.

[h1]AI Improvements[/h1]

[*] Units in the camps respond more proportionally to the priorities of the flags. As a whole group they only react to the Raid flag.

[/list]

[*] Added description of game modes in the main menu

[/list]

[h1]Other Improvements:[/h1]

Now every player can load and continue the interrupted multiplayer game, invite other players or replace them with bots. Shared cloud multiplayer autosaves are marked with the icon - [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/bbee3484d6d95f360cbeeefdfed67e8ee2ff1ade.png[/img][/list]

[*] The first mission of the first campaign (tutorial) can be skipped without any consequences.
[*] The tutorial elements in the second mission also can be skipped at any time.
[*] Steam cloud support optimizations
[*] FIXED human camp EXP bug
[*] FIXED Tutorial completion achievement not working (campaign) 
[*] FIXED "deleting Combat PoI without an encounter" crash
[*] FIXED "camp null poi" crash
[*] FIXED random multiplayer crash
[*] other minor bug fixes
[/list]

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

notes.title: OST Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/3a324f16f26c681fc95bb8879d7ff1a1c54dff49.jpg[/img]

We have a surprise for you ːsteamhappyː

[b]Original Game Soundtrack🎧 is now available free for all Driftland owners❤️[/b]
You already have it! It has been downloaded automatically with the latest update.

Since the debut in Early Access, we have been regularly asked about the availability of the Driftland's soundtrack. And here it is. 
The music in Driftland adapts to in-game events, it's mixed in real time, and consists of many layers (stems). Each of the four races has individual music that emphasizes its character. 
The soundtrack was mixed so that it would be a musical🎵 journey through the moods that you can experience during the game.

[h1]How to play downloaded Soundtrack DLC:[/h1]
1. Please select Music from the Library tab in the Steam client.  
2. From the list of available albums, choose Driftland: The Magic Revival - Soundtrack.
3. Press the PLAY ALBUM button to start the Steam music player

[h1]How to find Soundtrack files:[/h1]
1. Please select Music from the Library tab in the Steam client.  
2. From the list of available albums, choose Driftland: The Magic Revival - Soundtrack.
3. Choose the SHOW IN SYSTEM below PLAY ALBUM button to open the folder with the Soundtrack files in mp3 format.

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.10
notes.content:
This update primarily introduces [b]the Steam Cloud support[/b].

With this feature you can continue the mission of rebuilding the shattered planet on another computer while keeping all of your game progress.

Save games are still stored on the local disk but now also synchronized with the Steam cloud at the most appropriate moments. If you do not have access to the internet, everything will work the same but your progress in the game will be saved only locally.

[h1]Update Notes 1.0.10:[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Added Steam Cloud support
  [*]Fixed - Heroes do not upgrade their base skills to higher tiers while mounted [Bug]
  [*]a few minor fixes 
[/list]

Meanwhile, our team is undergoing intensive work on [b]a new campaign[/b], full of mysterious and surprising events. At the same time, some of us are working on the further development of the multiplayer game mode and a completely new [b]co-op mode[/b].
When it would be nice to let go and relax a bit, then we refine the gameplay mechanic, fix bugs and listen to what you have to say about Driftland to make it better ːsteamhappyː 

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.8
notes.content:
Dear Mages,

The most important change to this update is balancing an[b] easy level of difficulty[/b]. Mages who want to play in a more [b]relaxed[/b] manner should choose this level of difficulty. The difference in the game's balance compared to the previous versions will be most noticeable in Skirmish mode. AI has become less aggressive, which allows players to focus on the development of their own kingdom.
The second significant change is[b] the less intense narrative[/b] at the beginning of the first campaign. Because there were many dialogues mixed up with the tutorial, some of you considered it too much. We took it to heart and improved it.
[b]The improvements we introduce are only active in the newly started game - loading the saved game will cause some rules to remain unchanged.[/b]

[h1]Updated [b][u]Easy Mode[/u][/b]:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Limited AI aggression which is slowly increasing in the middle and end game.
    [*]AI is less likely to attack players who do not form large armies
    [*]AI empires attack with fewer units at once.
    [*]AI empires are more likely to enter into peace / alliance with the player
    [*]Pax Barbarian in the progress tree is active without the need to purchase it in the progress tree.
    [*]Elementals defending forests and mountains appear in the game later and usually without the largest and most powerful units.
    [*]The player gets an extra progress point per day
[/list]⬆️[u][b]The above changes apply only to an easy level of difficulty.[/b][/u]⬆️

It's been a week since the release of version 1.0. Although we are focused on developing the first major updateːsteamhappyː, which will bring new content and the fourth campaign, we carefully follow the forum, we analyze feedback. 

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Less intense narrative[/b] at the beginning of the first campaign.
    [*]Improved sorting of units on lists in camps and raid flags.
    [*]Better selection of colors, icons and names of kingdoms in some campaign missions.
    [*]Units are more actively defending their own area if the threat is close.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Fixed - random failure to complete some missions[/b]
    [*]Fixed - a multiplayer crash (PlayerState = NULL fix)
    [*]Fixed - "heroes from captured structures not healing"
    [*]Fixed - random error of the camp number
    [*]Fixed - duplicate dialogues
    [*]Fixed - displaying an incorrect numeric value of the treasure content
    [*]Fixed - trimming a numerical value in the skill purchase menu
    [*]Fixed - minor typo corrections
[/list]

We would like to thank all those who sent us emails or posted on the forum sharing their insights, remarks and bugs found with us. 
[b]For a small, independent team like Star Drifters, this is invaluable help, and whatever I write now I will not be able to express our gratitude.
[/b]

❤️❤️❤️
- Star Drifters team

notes.title: Driftland 1.0 Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/3dc2981b8ecd7eac5a69262370f19e1fc0e7a3c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dear Mages![/h1]

The day has come. We are proud to present you the officially released version of Driftland: The Magic Revival. After 4 years of hard work we are happy to share the final result with you. It is the game some of you already know, but now with key modes: multiplayer and 2 new campaigns. And just as we promised - it will leave Early Access once it is ready. We have a strong feeling it is now.

First of all, on behalf of our entire Star Drifters team, I would like to thank you, our wonderful community, for your tremendous support and lots of great ideas that you shared with us during the Early Access stage. Driftland debuted in EA over a year ago with the idea that it will help us test some of our original concepts. Never before have any of us done this, so we had no idea what to expect.

But reality has exceeded our expectations greatly.  Already in its initial versions, most players understood the spirit of our game, and many of you began to support us with brilliant ideas. We have quickly expanded the scope of what we want to fit in version 1.0 and with following updates we added new features and content. Together, we've had an exciting journey from an early version 0.4 which was more of a manifesto of the idea than a real game, through numerous updates to a full-fledged strategy game. 

We want to assure you that leaving Early Access does not mean the end of our working on Driftland. On the contrary - we want it to be bigger and better. The 4th campaign is already at an advanced stage of development, but that is just the beginning. Our list named [i]"cool ideas to do after full release"[/i] was waiting for this moment, so expect many surprisesːsteamhappyː

So once again - [b]THANK YOU![/b] 
It was an amazing adventure and it would never happen without you❤️


[h1]But many of you still do not know Driftland: The Magic Revival. So what is it exactly? What can you compare it to?[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/41098eb32ef91c8e9684ee7aa68f847db98c0f07.png[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kxgJGyRV3Yw
It does not cling only to one subgenre of strategy games, but boldly draws from all of them which we consider the best approach. The basis is the classic set of all 4 Xs: eXplore, eXpand, eXploit and eXterminate. To expand the kingdom, the player joins islands with bridges. Driftland is a real time strategy game, but with adjustable time flow and a very extensive active pause system. The player manages the kingdom through magic and the economy, issues orders and sets priorities for heroes recruited from the kingdom's population. Each unit is endowed with free will, has a name, a level, experience and a set of parameters that can be developed. Land units can tame and ride flying beasts, thanks to which they will be able to explore more distant areas. And all that is just a glimpse of what the game is about.

[h1]Now let me list the main features of Driftland, so that the new Mages would also know what to expect from our game:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Build a kingdom you want to rule[/b] - city building and upgrades of its buildings, expanding their capabilities - economic, military or their magical power
    [*][b]Dynamic topography[/b] - Move and terraform floating islands of the shattered planet
    [*][b]Get to know the rich lore[/b] - 4 different races with unique skills, each one speaking their own language, and different points of view on the Driftland’s story. One player to bring them all and in the darkness bind… oh, you know the drill.
    [*][b]Paths of progress[/b] - Economy, Warfare and Magic upgrades purchased for progress points
    [*][b]Economy is key[/b] - Resources, population and magic-based economy
    [*][b]Don’t forget about Diplomacy[/b] - Reputation system, alliances, wars and everything in between
    [*][b]Face various Victory Conditions[/b] - Extermination, Domination, Expansion
    [*][b]Give your citizens Orders[/b] - Setting goals instead of micro-management units
    [*][b]Development of units[/b] - Units have names, gain EXP, levels and unique skills
    [*][b]Flying units[/b] - Enhance units by bonding them with tamed flying beasts including dragons or Dwarven-built aerial machines
    [*][b]Game Modes[/b] - Skirmish, Campaign and Multiplayer
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/c1041834c8a591d99470c3a415da653d8554f7c1.png[/img]

In addition to the new content, this update introduces many improvements and fixes. The most important of them relates probably to the balance which we introduced to the game during the testing of the multiplayer mode.

[h1]Update Notes 1.0:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Two new campaigns[/b] - further stories, a lot of new graphics, animations, etc.
    [*][b]Multiplayer[/b] - 2-6 players, chat, time flow set by voting, bots, load/save, friends invitations
    [*][b]AI improvements[/b] - artificial intelligence becomes cleverer and a little more... human - better manages its army, interrupts attacks doomed to failure, smarter issues orders, avoids overspending building maintenance eg. is not spamming towers on distant islands
    [*][b]Dialogue log in the Campaign[/b] - the record of past dialogues has been added in the Mission Objectives window 
    [*][b]Improved dwarfish balance[/b] - reduced costs of buildings closer to other races, slightly reinforced units, construction of castle III requires "blacksmith" instead of "fortifications_I", slightly faster movement of units (still the slowest race in the game)
    [*][b]Balance adjustments and fixes[/b] - skills have become more effective (especially for the heroes of the human race), and other small adjustments that improve gameplay balance. 
    [*]Set of new and reworked animations.
    [*][b]4 new achievements[/b]🏆
    [*]bug fixes and many smaller improvements
[/list]

We are greateful for your continuous help and looking forward 🧐 to your feedback on this and subsequent updates.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/378b473724db24967932534416f01f09768382a6.png[/img]
May your lands remain unshattered,
- Star Drifters Team

May your lands remain unshattered,

We already started using our new editor in the process of building the first Campaign (that has all it’s missions already planned in detail). This is the second consecutive Update focused on fixing issues you report, because before releasing the story mode, we want to be sure the game’s stable, enjoyable and free of bugs that would be more difficult to eliminate afterwards. We also want it to be a complete experience, so there are two big features we want to share with you, before we let you shape the story of Emeryk, Urias and other characters important for the future of Driftland.

[h1]Update Notes 0.6.84: Children of the Monolith[/h1]

Honor, courage and cutting-edge technology (with a little bit of stubborness) have just become an integral part of Driftland! The last playable race, the Dwarves, await your wise orders and a bunch of great new features based on your feedback came with them, as well! This Update is BIG!

[h1]New race: Dwarves[/h1][list]
[*]Building-repairing Explorers and 3 unique Heroes (Berserker, Engineer and Geomancer) with 3 unique and powerful Aerial Machines (Glider, Zeppelin and Frigate), making for a total of 7 new Units!
[*]Enriched gunpowder or Lava Bomb? 12 new Dwarven skills to further customize your Heroes (and 3 skills of the Aerial Machines, too)!
[*]Unique Geomancy magic with 5 new spells, like resource-revealing Soil Speach!
[*]New architecture, sounds and music (with choirs singing in Dwarven)!
[*]New fiery biom type!
[*]Dwarven language (the 4th language created for the game)!
[*]3 new Achivements (Dwarven Adept, Dwarven Leader and Dwarven Overlord)
[/list]

[*]Dwarves can raise Anti-Magic Statues, buildings that accumulate Empire’s Mana, forming a barier that absorbs enemy spells!

[*]Dark Elves can build Palisades around their islands, and unlock their field of magic resistance in 2 new Advancements in Paths of Progress!
[*]Wild Elves can unlock Mallevah’s Favor spell with 2 new Advancements in Paths of Progress, gaining a ritual that protects their land from enemy magic!
[/list]
[h1]Race-unique Behaviour[/h1][list]
[*]Dwarven Explorers will look for damaged structures and repair them!
[*]Wild Elven Explorers will plant healing roseberry bushes for all your Units!
[*]And there’s more to come!

[*]Updated animations
[*]Updated loading screens
[*]New Single Player starting screen
[*]New Credits screen
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]
With all the playable races now in the game, our main focus will be on Campaigns, Multiplayer and balance of the game. As always, huge thanks to everyone in our Community for your neverending support!

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

notes.content:
Small step for a game, one giant leap for the Players! Sometimes one change can make a really huge difference and, speaking about steps and leaps, this is the case - your Units will now be able to run, basing the decission to move their feet faster on their profession and current situation. Now, the game’s even more enjoyable, with better pace and Heroes that simply feel more alive! Also, we added epic new music for the Wild Elves to make the overall experience more… epic! Here’s a list of all the changes:

[h1]Running / Walking Units:[/h1][list]
[*]All Units can now choose between walking and running, better adapting to various situations. If your Castle is under siege, there’s no time for laziness!
[/list]
[h1]New Music:[/h1][list]
[*]We changed sountrack for the Wild Elves - it’s more atmosperic, detailed and adapts to the situation in the game (like in all other races)! It’s sung in Elvish, too.
[/list]
[h1]Other Improvements:[/h1][list]
[*]Improved AI (including already mentioned running or avoiding enemy turrets)
[*]Bug Fixes (for example, you can now save the game after winning)
[/list]
We are also approaching final stages of Dwarves’ developement process - we can’t wait to share the neat new biome type, new Units, spells and gameplay possibilities with all of you! Fortunatelly, they are just around the corner!

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/34aba4df3ff2e28ad69fe011b00797e7a84974df.png[/img]

[h1]Update Notes: 0.5.12 [Early Access][/h1]

Highly requested Active Pause, 2 totally new Victory Conditions and reworked Barbarians, now consisting of 12 new Unit types divided into 4 groups - all of these new features await you in the Update for Driftland: The Magic Revival!

This time, we are counting on your feedback even more than usually. The new elements are already developed enough to give you lots of fun and increased replayability, but we want to know YOUR vision of the features before finishing them. This game is made for you, so play, test and tell us what tweaks and changes you’d want to see!

[h1]Active Pause:[/h1][list]
[*]One of the most requested features is finally here! You can enter or leave the Active Pause mode anytime be either pressing a spacebar or using the Pause icon that replaced the slowdown option. In the Mode you are able to take any actions (build, place flags etc.) except spellcasting, which requires time.
[/list]
[h1]New Victory Conditions:[/h1][list]
[*]Extermination: The basic and already well-known goal. Destroy all enemy Castles.
[*]Expansion: New optional objective. Expand you Empire, seizing control of the set amount of islands.
[*]Domination: New optional objective. Capture and control a set number of Antique Tellurions or Ravaged Mausoleums.
[/list]
[h1]New Barbarians:[/h1][list]
[*]Clan of the Anvil: Anvil’s Champion, Anvil’s Rifleman and Anvil’s Shaman.
[*]Barbarians: Bruiser, Savage and Witch Doctor.
[*]Shyh’yr: Shyh’yr Vindicator, Shyh’yr Archer and Shyh’yr Priest.
[*]Barbaric Elves: Lost Warrior, Lost Ranger and Lost Druid
[/list]
Apart from that, we added or improved various visuals elements, like new flare effects. So, what’s next? As I wrote earlier, we plan to further develop the new features, improve Units management and start working on localisation of the game. After that, the time will come for Dwarves, the fourth playable race!

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

notes.title: Update Notes: 0.5.3 [Early Access] Descendants of Mallevah
notes.content:
The Wild Elves are here!

3 new Heroes with 13 new skills, 9 new spells with 4 of them found in the Wild Summoning - the entirely new school of magic, exclusive to the descendants of Queen Mallevah await you in the Update. If that’s not enough, there’s a new biom type, architecture, sounds and music, too!

It doesn’t matter if you prefer to focus on powerful healing, strong flying Heroes or skills that empower your Units on your enchanted biom, these damage (and healing) over time hermits will have the right tools to match your desired strategy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/120a6843e4c1557a8762a0305e7438bd50851c6d.gif[/img]

[h1]Wild Elves bring you:[/h1][list]
[*]3 new Heroes: Warrior, Ranger and Druid
[*]13 new skills for your Heroes (like Heart of the Forest or Tattoo of the Bear)
[*]Wild Summoning - new school of magic with 2 types of Golems and 2 types of Ents awaiting your call
[*]5 new spells (like Thorn Grove)
[*]New Paths of Progress Advancement - Nature’s Protection
[*]New biom type
[*]New architecture, music and sounds
[*]3 new Achivements (Wild Elven Adept, Wild Elven Leader and Wild Elven Overlord)
[/list]
As always, I’d like to thank our entire Community for all your feedback and I’m looking forward to hear from you about the Update! Dwarves are already on the way, but before that, we plan to add some new and highly requested features - like the active pause!

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

notes.title: Update Notes: 0.4.221 [Early Access]
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Mages!
We did it countless times individually, but once again we want to thank you, our great Community, for all your detailed feedback and any other means of helping us! We are a small team, and couldn’t do it with you.
Again, we adressed the things you recently told us about, releasing the Update with two major improvements in mind:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/7bc309bf425dfe86085551d947c9fb5ba7b5f134.gif[/img]

[h1]Basic economy clarified:[/h1][list]
[*]We are aware that some of you found balancing basic resources (especially Gold) unclear, so we reworked the way the system is shown to you. It’s now easier to understand that your basic Gold income comes from Citizens assigned to Cottages and your Castle and in case you find yourself to be in red, you will be able to easily put your finances back in order!
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/48e9847adbf4f8e47667e2815f354c60a3c6a697.png[/img]

[h1]Improved AI:[/h1][list]
[*]New difficulty levels will now affect not only your economy values, but also your enemies’ behaviour. That includes a list of various changes: from the amount of recruited Heroes to attacking your bridges!
[*]You now have bigger control over your Units, with the new ability to order them to abandon their current tasks. Just look for a new button in their window!
[/list]
[h1]Other improvements:[/h1][list]
[*]Discover new Paths of Progress Advancements!
[*]Develop new skills for your Heroes!
[*]Enjoy the added Units’ voices (they all speak in their races’ languages)!
[*]Rule your Empire listening to new, epic music!
[*]Savor the improved graphics of the Dark Elven models!
[*]...among other improvements and fixes!
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30811282/121a60c401f872d9f8aa241899b3d9b579f02771.png[/img]

And one more thing… there’s only one week before the next Update (check out the game to find more details)! :)

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

notes.title: Update Notes: 0.4.155 [Early Access]
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Mages!
After releasing previous update for Drifltand, we were extremely happy to hear that we added the things you wished for. To avoid resting on our laurels, we were working really hard over last month to again provide you with an update matching your expectation. Bigger diversity of races, more active enemies or suicidal tendencies of Heroes were things a lot of you mentioned, so keep reading to see how we dealt with those things (and to learn about some surprises)!

[h1]New feaures:[/h1][list]
[*]New Reputation system tells you how you are seen by your subjects. Add new islands to your Empire, raise new buildings, claim treasures and avoid hunger or deaths of your Heroes to keep it high - it affects your Gold income and determines your Population growth rate (number of Citizens no longer affects Population growth). 
[*]New skill system: You told us about bigger diversity of races and the first step has been taken. Unit skill system has been completely reworked - there’s a unique set of skills for each Race (Warlocks can steal health of enemies to heal their allies or sacrifice themselves for the good of the Empire while Knights are durable fighters, capable of leading other Heroes into the fray). All the skills have Tiers now, and each upgrade of Blacksmith or Library allows you to increase their potential, often greatly changing the way they work! Additionaly, the Player’s spells for Dark Elves are visually reworked and first of them (Black Ice) has a new mechanic.
[/list]
[h1]Major changes:[/h1][list]
[*]Improved AI: That’s another thing we talked about with our amazing community - no more idle enemies or suicidal Heroes! Enemy Empires will scout your lands and plan attacks while your own wounded Units will withdraw from battles, depending on their personality. Imploding enemy island is not that easy anymore, too.
[*]Paths of Progress: There are now 3 Paths, with new Advancements and reduced costs. From now on, you will also gather Progress Points from various events, like adding islands or killing a dragon - not only from the House of Scholars.
[*]We reworked the map to make it look better and feel more practical.
[*]Upkeep cost now increases by 2 on each consecutive island (instead of being increased by number of additional islands squared).
[*]A choice of color for Players’ Empires has been added.
[*]Additional sounds have been added.
[*]Luke’s hair has been reduced to 0 an he is now bald.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1][list]
[*]Additional improvements and bug fixes
[/list]
There are still some Unit skills we are adding to the game (there will be 5 per Blacksmith, Shooting Range and Library and at least 1 per Castle and Marketplace) and the new race is on the way! As always, let us know what you think and together, let's make Driftland the best game we can all think of!

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

After releasing previous update for Drifltand, we were extremely happy to hear that we added the things you wished for. To avoid resting on our laurels, we were working really hard over last month to again provide you with an update matching your expectation. Bigger diversity of races, more active enemies or suicidal tendencies of Heroes were things a lot of you mentioned, so keep reading to see how we dealt with those things (and to learn about some surprises)!

[h1]New feaures:[/h1][list]
[*]New Reputation system tells you how you are seen by your subjects. Add new islands to your Empire, raise new buildings, claim treasures and avoid hunger or deaths of your Heroes to keep it high - it affects your Gold income and determines your Population growth rate (number of Citizens no longer affects Population growth). 
[*]New skill system: You told us about bigger diversity of races and the first step has been taken. Unit skill system has been completely reworked - there’s a unique set of skills for each Race (Warlocks can steal health of enemies to heal their allies or sacrifice themselves for the good of the Empire while Knights are durable fighters, capable of leading other Heroes into the fray). All the skills have Tiers now, and each upgrade of Blacksmith or Library allows you to increase their potential, often greatly changing the way they work! Additionaly, the Player’s spells for Dark Elves are visually reworked and first of them (Black Ice) has a new mechanic.
[/list]
[h1]Major changes:[/h1][list]
[*]Improved AI: That’s another thing we talked about with our amazing community - no more idle enemies or suicidal Heroes! Enemy Empires will scout your lands and plan attacks while your own wounded Units will withdraw from battles, depending on their personality. Imploding enemy island is not that easy anymore, too.
[*]Paths of Progress: There are now 3 Paths, with new Advancements and reduced costs. From now on, you will also gather Progress Points from various events, like adding islands or killing a dragon - not only from the House of Scholars.
[*]We reworked the map to make it look better and feel more practical.
[*]Upkeep cost now increases by 2 on each consecutive island (instead of being increased by number of additional islands squared).
[*]A choice of color for Players’ Empires has been added.
[*]Additional sounds have been added.
[*]Luke’s hair has been reduced to 0 an he is now bald.
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1][list]
[*]Additional improvements and bug fixes
[/list]
There are still some Unit skills we are adding to the game (there will be 5 per Blacksmith, Shooting Range and Library and at least 1 per Castle and Marketplace) and the new race is on the way! As always, let us know what you think and together, let's make Driftland the best game we can all think of!

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

notes.title: Update Notes: 0.4.132 [Early Access]
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Mages!

The first Early Access update is here! Based on your feedback, we added new features (you can change the game speed or scale your UI) and improved some of the existing ones (you can stop your units from attacking an enemy island and Gold Mines are now much more profitable). Also, enemy Empires won’t instantly rebuild bridges (yeah!) and we dealt with some game-crashing bugs! You can see the full list here:

[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game speed settings: you can now set the game speed to one of 4 available options
[*]New bridges: there are 2 bridges available for both Humans and Dark Elves
[*]Controls tab is now unlocked in Game Settings, allowing you to set your own keybindings
[*]Master Volume has been added to Audio Settings
[*]UI scaling option has been added to Video Settings
[*]A Christmas tree has been added to our office
[/list]
[h1]Major changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Deleting an Attack Flag on enemy islands now stops the attack for all the Units involved
[*]Improved buildings placement on islands
[*]More profitable Gold Mines
[*]The cost of Ritual Implosion has been increased from 400 to 700 Mana
[*]The cost of Fireball has been reduced to 30 from 50 Mana and it can now be cast on enemy structures, not only enemy Units
[*]Improved spell effects for Fireball, Ice Shackles, Heal and Magic Eye
[*]Human / Dark Elven Adept, Human / Dark Elven Leader and Human / Dark Elven Overlord now requires 1/3/5 wins instead of 5/10/25
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enemy Empires don’t spam buildings (Bridges, Cottages or Watchtowers)
[*]VSYNC supports high refresh rate monitors
[*]Few bugs causing game crashes have been fixed
[*]Minor improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

Most of all, we are only getting started! You told us about bigger diversity of races and that’s one of the most important things we’re currently working on. New race is looming on the horizon too, so brace yourself as new content is already on the way.

Thank you all for your dedication, detailed feedback and tons of positive comments and reviews - you are amazing!

May your lands remain unshattered,
- Luke

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Mages!

We spent almost 3 years, working on a project that became an important part of our lifes - after all, that's not only a long time but also a lot of hard work and sacrifices we had to make.

We still need time to finish the game, but we also believe that it reached a stage where it's ready to be shared with you. That being said, we launch Early Access of Driftland: The Magic Revival... now!

[b]The features available to you now:[/b]
[list]
    [*]2 playable races: Humans and Dark Elves
    [*]Random generated maps with a lot of various settings
[/list]

[b]The features important things we plan to add during Early Access:[/b]
[list]
    [*]2 additional races: Dwarves and Wild Elves
    [*]4 intertwining Campaigns (one for each race)
    [*]Multiplayer
    [*]Balancing and bug fixes
[/list]

We plan to release updates every 2-4 weeks, so there will always be something to do in Driftland! Also, the game will be much cheaper during Early Access, so that's the best moment to get it.

We're looking forward to your feedback - after all, we make the game for you.

May your lands remain unshattered,
Luke

P.S. It's also one of our founders' birthday today. Happy Birthday, Michał! :)
